skill_name: Give an example of a real-world problem you can solve with GPT.
workflow: One example of a real-world problem that can be solved with GPT is natural language processing. Natural language processing involves understanding the structure, meaning and function of spoken sentences to form automatic responses or actions. GPT can be used to develop natural language processing models that can be used in applications like chatbots, document summarization, text-to-speech conversion, machine translation, and more.
